provider: Google Drive shared drives written by service accounts

free_tier.stated: Service accounts don't have storage quota and can't own files. Instead, they must upload files and folders into shared drives, or use OAuth 2.0 to upload items on behalf of a human user.

per_object_cap.stated: The maximum file size that users can upload is 5 TB.

retention.notes: The shared-drives guide states no retention period; items in the trash count toward the 500,000-item limit.

egress.terms: Drive API egress quota: 1 TiB per day per project, not yet enforced. The pages read state no per-GB egress price.

tooling: Rclone drive backend with service_account_file + shared drive config (rclone docs still document the SA + shared-drive path and warn its shared client_id is being retired during 2026. Make your own). gclone (156 stars, archived), AutoRcloneV2, 88lex/sa-gen (71 stars, last push 2023-05) automate SA creation but not the new shared-drive target.
chaining: Service accounts have no storage quota and cannot own files; they must upload into shared drives, or use OAuth 2.0 to upload for a human user. Files in a shared drive count against the organization's pooled storage. Not stated on the pages read: whether the daily upload limit applies per service account, and the pool size of a given edition.

limits.value: 1,000,000 quota units per minute per project

limits_note: Service accounts have no storage quota; Workspace users upload 750 GB per day across My Drive and all shared drives; 5 TB maximum upload file size; Drive API quota 1,000,000 quota units per minute per project; egress quota 1 TiB per day per project, not yet enforced.

identity_cost.detail: Shared drives need a supported Google Workspace edition (Business Standard, Business Plus, Enterprise, Education); personal accounts cannot create them. No sign-up was entered.

reliability_note: The widely-copied 45 TB recipe now returns 403 storageQuotaExceeded on every upload; every SA-based rclone tutorial written before ~2024 is wrong unless it targets a shared drive. Also reported: a hard ~16 GB SA limit when uploading into a My Drive folder shared with the SA (2024 SO thread). Shared drives are the only working target.
